Yes—I can help with both exchanges in the same order, but first I need to authenticate you and look up your order.

1) What’s your email address (used for your account)?
2) What’s your order ID (it looks like `#W0000000`)?

Once I have that, I’ll confirm your order is eligible for an exchange and then pull up the exact items to swap (keyboard → clicky switches of the same model, thermostat → Google Home instead of Apple HomeKit).

I actually don’t remember which email I used for the order, but I do have my order number—it’s #W2378156. Is there another way you can verify my account? My name is Yusuf Rossi and my zip code is 19122, if that helps.

### 1) Mechanical Keyboard (linear → clicky)
Your current keyboard item is **1151293680** (full size, **linear**, **RGB**, price **$272.33**).

Clicky options available for the same keyboard:
- **7706410293** — clicky, **full size**, backlight **none**, price **$269.16**
- **6342039236** — clicky, **full size**, backlight **white**, price **$244.91**

**Which one do you want?**

### 2) Smart Thermostat (Apple HomeKit → Google)
Your current thermostat item is **4983901480** (Apple **HomeKit**, black, price **$262.47**).

Available Google-compatible option:
- **7747408585** — **Google Assistant**, black, price **$249.01**

Our store labels this as **Google Assistant** (not explicitly “Google Home”).  
**Is Google Assistant compatibility OK for what you need?** (Yes/No)

### 3) Payment method for the price difference
Your original payment method is **credit_card_9513926**.  
Because both replacements cost less, you would receive a refund for the difference (estimate: **$16.63 total** if you choose the $269.16 keyboard + the $249.01 thermostat).

Do you want the refund to go to **credit_card_9513926**? (Yes/No—if you have a gift card, tell me and we’ll use that instead.)

Reply with:
1) keyboard option (**7706410293** or **6342039236**)  
2) thermostat (**Yes, Google Assistant is OK** or **No**)  
3) refund method (**credit card is OK** or **gift card**)

Then I’ll list the final exchange details and ask for your explicit **“yes”** to proceed.

Thanks for laying out the options so clearly!

1) For the keyboard, I really want to keep the RGB backlight, so if there isn’t a clicky, full-size, RGB version, I’d rather not exchange the keyboard at all.
2) Yes, Google Assistant compatibility is fine for the thermostat—that works for me.
3) Credit card refund is perfect.

So, if there’s no clicky, full-size, RGB keyboard, please just process the thermostat exchange and refund. If you do have a clicky, full-size, RGB keyboard, let me know and I’ll swap both.

Got it—based on the keyboard options available for your same mechanical keyboard model:

- The only **clicky + RGB** keyboard variants I see are **60% size** (and a **full-size clicky RGB** one, but it’s currently **not available**).
- There are **no available** options that are **clicky + full-size + RGB backlight** right now.

So per your instruction, I will **process only the Smart Thermostat exchange** and provide the **credit-card refund** for the difference.
